notes.title: Developer update: Patch notes 10/11/2020
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34604608/9bc3faf03ef983dde0b880a79add5958374e14cb.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

Thank you for your continued support and feedback of Tears of Avia. We have been working hard and are happy to introduce new bug fixes and balance changes to the world of Estera. Please see the full list below:

[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
- Can no longer move onto the same tile as another player that is also in progress of moving to 
- Deft strike, swap and teleport now allow moves to undo correctly to the tile you teleported to rather than the tile you started the turn at 
- Buffs should no longer 'miss' targets with high def
- game hanging when triggering achievements 
- damage numbers displaying twice
- Desert 2 damage challenge now works as advertised 
- Clicking the base panel while a skill is being targeted no longer leaves the target indicator visible 
- Fixed an issue where sometimes graphics settings would not save 
- Formatting issue on the deploy screen that caused Prisoner 1337's name to overlap 
- fixes triggering of the legion/long shot achievements 
- summon spiders no longer bug out when skipped
- Source of sorrow challenges now work as intended - Frozen city 2 had some active tiles floating in empty space 
- Icy wastes 2 challenges now work as intended
- Orphanage challenges work as intended
- Achievement for completing all the challenges should now trigger correctly
- You no longer take reflected damage when you own a reflect totem and heal an ally
- Damage numbers appear when the attack strikes, rather than when the attack ends for: zombie punches, slash, fireball, firebolt and energy bolt
- fixes fire and lightning shields such that they are despawned if the wielder is defeated
- you can now assign space bar as a bindable key
- pipework dusters no longer display the wrong model
- Nosaram now performs his split phase when you reload a hardcore save at the split phase point
- When you spend ID scrolls, the ID scroll counts are updated in the inventory/shop screens
- Swap skill no longer fails when skipping the animation
- Collateral damage should now do 25% of the damage as specified rather than 100%

[h3][b]Balance/Game Changes[/b][/h3]
- Nerfed priest XP gain
- Right clicking and dragging off of keybinds no longer leaves all buttons in a highlighted state 
- Made adjustments to the way loot is generated to promote more potential desired stat drops
- Clicking on the back tooltip while assigning new keys now closes keybind assign mode 
- If you use teleport on a mage portal, you will now also travel down the portal after teleporting 
- If you summon a creature onto a mage portal, that creature will be teleported down the portal 
- Summons can now undo moves after their first turn deployed 
- Rebalances catacomb and swamp levels in standard mode
- You can no longer 'end turn' when the 'stage clear' banner appears using a joypad
- Improves the shrine screen UI



We are constantly listening to your feedback and looking at ways to improve the game. 

Thank you for your support! 

- CooCooSqueaky & PQube 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34604608/6e7278a8546d166324bc0fbfafd9584ecb6efe9c.png[/img]

notes.title: Developer update: Patch notes 20/10/2020
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34604608/79847f99e972060cb55f8d8134f70a97f2cb6a35.png[/img]


Hey everyone,

Firstly, thank you all very much for supporting Tears of Avia! It has been a passion project fuelled over the past few years. Now the game is out and in your hands, we wanted to provide a steady stream of updates through regular patch notes! Please see below for our first batch of bug fixes and balance changes. 

[h3][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h3]
- Item dupe glitch
- Bug that prevented progress in the apex of eternity if Afren has local passive buffs
- Fixes a bug in Mechanophage where all the party members would appear ontop of each other
- Fixes a crash in the mine boss
- Fixes a bug in the final boss if you re-try it for a second time
- Adjustments to the way sounds are played to avoid in-game SFX cutting out
- Fixes an issue where cameras would be stuck on the ground if you died while taking reflected damage
- Fixes summoning level 5 animal summons failing to show up
- Fixes skipping summoning bear not actually summoning the bear
- Partially fixes keybindings in battle maps
- Using deft strike near a level border edge locks gameplay
- You can now talk to the prisoner in the desert tavern
- You can no longer displace immovable giant bosses with shockwave
- The meteor strike sound playing even if you target no enemies



[h3][b]Balance/game changes [/b][/h3]
- Nerfed reflect to cap damage to no more than 50% of the player's maximum life
- Totem information is now displayed on the map confirm screen
- If you take reflected damage the damage number is shown on you with the word reflected to indicate as such
- Increased the variety of items on the Tirig blacksmith
- Adds levels to the players/enemies on the Tirig arena screen
- Changes the description of upgrade shards to properly reflect the tier skills would get upgraded to
- Allows you to proceed in the Tirig arena using a joypad
- Slight nerf to blackwater bay 2 bandits
- You can now skip enemy movement (if there are no traps in their path)
- Better loot drops in all grasslands levels prior to the bay levels
- Expanded the camera border in a couple of levels


We are constantly listening to your feedback and looking at ways to improve the game. 

Thank you for your support! 

- CooCooSqueaky & PQube 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34604608/6e7278a8546d166324bc0fbfafd9584ecb6efe9c.png[/img]

notes.title: Character overview: Kai
notes.content:
Hello all,

We have a new character overview for you! We would like to introduce one of the knights in Tears of Avia, Kai. If a strong will and unwavering dedication is important to you, Kai is definitely one for your party!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34604608/249b4445138cb4dbd6725c71f9c9028cdd5809fc.png[/img]

[h2]Who is Kai?[/h2]
Kai possesses a strong heart and an iron resolve when it comes to his convictions. As a young boy growing up in the great city of Tirig, he always admired the revered knights of Tirig, warriors clad not just in armor but also in honor. As he grew and trained, he found himself disappointed with the lazy guards that surrounded him and continues to dream of the day when he could prove himself among the greatest knights.

[h2]Building Kai's skills[/h2]
Kai is a strong close-range warrior! But don’t under-estimate his support abilities. He can mitigate damages just as well as he can inflict “Damage over Time” to his enemies. Add to his set a few buffs for your party, and you have a perfect mix!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34604608/1481e6fb6ac389425b999ab49824eddce335f9bc.png[/img]

[h2]What is Tears of Avia?[/h2]
Tears Of Avia is a Strategy RPG and turn-based tactics game set in the beautiful world of Estera. 

Build a party of charismatic allies and utilise the vast skill-tree system to combine classes and skills in a limitless number of ways. Lead your party across Estera in search of the lost city of Avalon, engaging in thrilling turn-based battles in this unique tactical experience.

Coming to PC and Xbox One in Summer 2020. See our latest gameplay trailer here:

[previewyoutube=f_QuJU5tp2s;full][/previewyoutube]

- PQube and CooCooSqueaky


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34604608/6e7278a8546d166324bc0fbfafd9584ecb6efe9c.png[/img]

notes.title: Character overview: Iris
notes.content:
Hello all,

We have a new character overview for you! This time, we wanted to introduce one of the mage's in Tears of Avia, Iris. Having this pyromaniac, hot-headed girl in your party can be especially useful against some of the elemental foes you will face in your journey. Just don't get on her bad side. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34604608/42a688fbcb031948e38659ca69a00fd4fab15ae3.png[/img]

[h2]Who is Iris?[/h2]
As a self-assured master of magic, Iris is the quintessential Mage, brimming with a confidence only matched by her ego. After her days spent under the tutelage of a master, she now roams across the continent searching for ancient tomes or trinkets in long forgotten places. Anything that will make the impatient mage stronger. Though her goals would probably be easier if she did not have the slightest streak of pyromania...


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34604608/dae205a99c59f885b946cb18b30ac92e90769778.gif[/img]


[h2]Building Iris' skills[/h2]
While Iris might excel in fire magic, she is far from limited to pyromancy. Her abilities range from buffs and debuffs to 'Damage Over Time' which will help you vanquish your foes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34604608/5d447bd0bcefe6d6c3b903a3ca71676e6f5a65bc.png[/img]

notes.title: Character overview: Momoko
notes.content:
Hello all!

Welcome to week three of character overviews of Tears of Avia. This week we wanted to focus on Momoko, a 'priest' class character who you will meet in your journey this summer! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34604608/6269da1fce91b4f47c99fe2d287a317e10c70107.png[/img]

[h2]Who is Momoko?[/h2]
Selfless and caring, Momoko’s only true wish is to be useful as a Priestess of Liathi. Growing up in an orphanage in the Nemeton Forest, the priestesses there taught her about the light of Liathi and how her presence warmed all of Estera. A wide-eyed young Momoko fell into the teachings, learning everything she could from the women who raised her. Once she’d learned the sum of their knowledge, she left the orphanage seeking to learn more and spread Liathi’s light to all corners of the world.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34604608/821d84a5f1c7b19c7df909b86df51757e593611d.png[/img]


[h2]Building Momoko's skills[/h2]
Momoko offers more than just healing support to your party. Build her skills and give her the ability to clear your party of ailments and boost their stats, vital for some of the encounters in your journey across Estera. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34604608/51ab87680a6add88fc67120f7724aa53e9ca35e3.png[/img]

notes.title: Character overview: Raul
notes.content:
Hello all!

Continuing our week-by-week character overview of some of the main faces you'll meet in Tears of Avia, this week we wanted to shine a light on one of Estera's brawlers, Raul. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34604608/f21407b22bb42c321e8fb6020899f0f76787290b.png[/img]


[h2]Who is Raul?[/h2]
Raul’s days were spent carrying goods for people more wealthy than he, but his nights were filled with tavern brawls, several pints of ale, and if he was lucky, a woman. All the things he needed to put a smile on his face and a pulse in his heart. Still, every morning there was a feeling in his chest that ached for something more. Ached for a destiny that brought purpose to the strength behind his fists.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34604608/3c933fb70c684ebf8db87d8f1f67de15057902ef.png[/img]


[h2]Building Raul's skills[/h2]
Raul is a brawler by class, his only weapons are his punches and kicks. However just because he does not wield a weapon doesn't mean he isn't worthy to be placed into your party. You can build Raul's abilities to make him an agile, blood thirsty superhuman, with bone-crushing power in every blow. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34604608/a2f982aa7c43ee7bea131e7671fc1fd558df428d.png[/img]

notes.title: Character overview: Reina
notes.content:
Hey Steam Community!

As you eagerly await the release of Tears of Avia, we wanted to provide you with a week-by-week character overview of some of the main characters, starting with Reina, Tears of Avia's very own Ranger. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34604608/787a4862eba2399e273be39d6eea955f54e2cbaf.png[/img]


[h2]Who is Reina?[/h2]
Reina's grounded approach to the world serves her well as an adaptable Ranger. She spends most of her days hunting the wilds of Estera and living off the land, only rarely making her way to civilization to bolster her supplies... or for the odd card game. But as calculated as she is, all risks measured and weighed, she always comes out ahead, whether it's trapping game or bluffing villagers.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34604608/82d4d7bc523c699fe4651aed96aaddf3158ec8bb.png[/img]


[h2]Building Reina's skills[/h2]
Being a ranger doesn't mean Reina is limited to her trusted bow and arrow. Progressing Reina's skill tree can lead you into the direction of 'Beast Mastery', allowing you to summon scorpions, bears and even dragons. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34604608/83ff7d2443c4199454e8c18940848263fde9e540.png[/img]
